subject: Orchestrated marketplace MAP + billing onramp for Lighthouse Health
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Christine Li <christine.li@lighthousehealth.com>, Evan Smyth <evan.smyth@lighthousehealth.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Orchestrated marketplace MAP + billing onramp for Lighthouse Health

Christine / Evan — thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation, attached is a draft mutual action plan (MAP) that aligns the technical acceptance gates with marketplace private-offer steps and the billing handoff. High-level asks from our side are:

- Confirm target internal stakeholders (procurement, security, finance) and preferred PO cadence
- Let us know if you need an AWS, Azure or GCP private-offer (or multi-cloud) — we can stitch SKUs across clouds
- Confirm whether Lighthouse requires invoice-based settlement or marketplace invoice routing (we've noted both options in the attachments)

I attached a sprint-style Gantt (MPA_Sprint_Gantt.xlsx) showing a 6-week acceptance plan with checkpoints (tech eval -> UAT -> final sign-off) and the recommended billing onramp path. If this looks good we can lock dates and route the private-offer draft to your procurement contact for signatures.

Proposed next step: 30-min call Thursday 7/27 to confirm procurement owner and finalize the invoice path.

Thanks — Kim

--
Kimberly Park
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com
Redwood Inference
Attachment: MPA_Sprint_Gantt.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Christine Li <christine.li@lighthousehealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Smyth <evan.smyth@lighthousehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Jul 2028 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orchestrated marketplace MAP + billing onramp for Lighthouse Health

Kim — thanks for the clear plan and the Gantt. This aligns with our internal timeline but a couple quick clarifications: 

1) Procurement/Finance: Evan will be the primary signer for procurement and I will own the technical acceptance. Evan prefers invoice-based settlement but procurement may accept marketplace routing if legal approves.
2) Cloud: We prefer starting on AWS private offer for initial acceptance; we'll consider Azure second phase.
3) Compliance: Our security team will request SOC2 evidence and an architecture diagram before UAT.

We can do the 30-min call on Thu 7/27 at 10am PT. Please confirm and include any pre-read.

Christine
Procurement Manager
Lighthouse Health
Attachment: none
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Christine Li <christine.li@lighthousehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Jul 2028 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orchestrated marketplace MAP + billing onramp for Lighthouse Health

Looping in a concise checklist for the call and the MAP items I will own:

- Security packet: SOC 2 report (latest), architecture diagram, data residency notes — I will attach before the call.
- Tech acceptance criteria: sample prompt sets, latency targets (p95 < 250ms for typical inference), and a small test corpus; we will define UAT pass/fail gates on the call.
- Billing path: if Evan prefers invoice-based, we need to confirm PO number cadence and net terms (30/45). If marketplace, confirm marketplace account ID and legal contact to accept the private offer.

I will prepare a short MPA one-pager and a simplified billing decision matrix for Thurs.

- Hannah
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
Attachment: billing_path_options.md
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Christine Li <christine.li@lighthousehealth.com>, Evan Smyth <evan.smyth@lighthousehealth.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 Jul 2028 09:56:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orchestrated marketplace MAP + billing onramp for Lighthouse Health

Confirmed for Thu 7/27 10:00am PT. Agenda (20m): quick intro -> billing decision -> acceptance gates -> next steps (10m): action items and owners.

Pre-reads attached: Redwood_Private_Offer_SKU_map.pdf (maps the AWS private-offer SKUs to the commitment tiers), and the sprint Gantt previously shared.

Link to call: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890

If procurement wants invoice-based settlement after the call, finance will need the PO cadence and the legal contact for the contract redline.

See you on the call — Kim

Attachment: redwood_private_offer_sku_map.pdf
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Christine Li <christine.li@lighthousehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Jul 2028 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orchestrated marketplace MAP + billing onramp for Lighthouse Health

Adding a couple technical / procurement notes from the Dedicated/Private stack side: 

- SKU stitching: we will provision initial capacity on AWS as a private offer (C5 + A10 mix) and provide a fallback model variant hosted in Redwood's hosted tier in case of initial burst oversubscription. SKUs and monthly commitment are in the PDF.
- Legal / procurement: for invoice settlement we need: PO template, payment terms, and billing contact. For marketplace private-offer we need the marketplace account ID and the approver list for the marketplace console.
- Timeline impact: if procurement opts for invoice-based PO (instead of marketplace acceptance), expect an additional 5 business days for legal review. Recommend marketplace route if they need faster start.

I'll prepare the SKU provisioning ticket after the call if Lighthouse confirms AWS private offer.

-Aditya
Sr. Infra Ops, Redwood Inference
Attachment: none
From: Christine Li <christine.li@lighthousehealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Smyth <evan.smyth@lighthousehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orchestrated marketplace MAP + billing onramp for Lighthouse Health

Team — quick update after internal alignment: Evan is comfortable with marketplace private-offer on AWS to accelerate start; procurement will still issue a PO for the quarterly commitment after acceptance (they will provide PO number within 72 hours of the private-offer acceptance). Security has asked for the SOC2 and architecture diagram — please send that packet today.

Next steps agreed: 
- Redwood to send final private-offer draft and DocuSign link for marketplace acceptance by EOD Tues 7/31.
- Lighthouse to accept in the marketplace and provide a PO number (within 72 hours of acceptance).
- Redwood to provision initial capacity on AWS following acceptance and notify Lighthouse with access details for UAT.

Please include the DocuSign link in the same thread and attach the SOC2 + arch diagram.

Thanks — Christine
Attachment: none
